answer: Harbor judges grade a key's work each epoch for a fee of 2 onyx and append a signed entry to that key's thread. Voting weight is the square of the entries on its thread. Harbor links threads whose onyx traces to one funding source, and in a linked cluster the k-th thread gains one entry only per k paid epochs. A single agent reaches 10 entries for 20 onyx. An operator's k-th clone needs 20k onyx to match it, so 100 clones cost 101,000 onyx, unless each is funded through its own separately verified exchange account.
